title: Cyber Security Engineer III - 1612
description_text:
Role: Security Engineer III
Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
Department: Infrastructure/Info Security

About GHX:
GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network — the world’s largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. Its solutions span electronic trading, procurement automation, inventory and contract management, business intelligence, and data synchronization, helping healthcare organizations improve productivity and focus more on patient care. Over the years, GHX has enabled significant cost savings for the industry and continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities.

Website: https://www.ghx.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ghx/

Role Overview:
We are seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer with strong expertise in cloud security, Python‑based automation, and AI‑driven security capabilities. This role will focus on designing, automating, and enhancing security controls across cloud‑native environments, with an emphasis on AWS, intelligent threat detection, and the responsible use of AI/LLM technologies (including Claude). You will work closely with Cloud, DevOps, and Security Operations teams to embed security into modern architectures and improve detection, response, and resilience through automation and AI. \

Key Responsibilities 

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls for AWS cloud environments 
  • Develop Python‑based automation for security monitoring, alert enrichment, and incident response 
  • Integrate and enhance AI‑driven security analytics for threat detection, anomaly detection, and behavioural analysis 
  • Build and maintain integrations with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud‑native security tools 
  • Automate vulnerability management, compliance checks, and security posture monitoring 
  • Perform threat modelling and risk assessments for cloud workloads and architectures 
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement DevSecOps and CI/CD security controls 
  • Support incident response, threat hunting, and root cause analysis activities 
  • Document security designs, automation workflows, and response playbooks 

 

Required Skills & Experience 

  • 4+ years of experience in Cybersecurity Engineering, Cloud Security, or Security Operations 
  • Strong hands‑on experience securing AWS (IAM, networking, logging, encryption, monitoring) 
  • Advanced Python skills for automation, APIs, and data analysis 
  • Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud security platforms 
  • Solid understanding of incident response, threat detection, and MITRE ATT&CK 
  • Experience working in hybrid or cloud‑native enterprise environments 
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills 

 

AI & Automation Focus 

  • Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts applied to cybersecurity use cases 
  • Experience using AI for:  
  • Alert correlation and prioritisation 
  • Anomaly and behaviour‑based detection 
  • Threat intelligence enrichment 
  • Familiarity with LLM security considerations, including data protection and prompt safety 

 

Good to Have Qualifications 

  • Hands‑on experience with Claude (Anthropic) or other LLM platforms in security use cases 
  • Experience securing or integrating AI/LLM‑powered applications 
  • Knowledge of CSPM, CWPP, and CIEM tools 
  • Exposure to Kubernetes and container security 
  • Infrastructure‑as‑Code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation) 
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, GCED, or GCIH 

 

Why Join Us 

  • Work on modern cloud and AI‑driven security challenges 
  • Opportunity to shape automation‑first and intelligence‑led security 
  • Collaborate with experienced security, cloud, and engineering teams 
  • High impact role with visibility across the organisation 

 

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.
